remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946....No signature [note of backing inscription 1]. Also initial. Red, green and yellow apples (10 of them – one small one at left)....See gallery photograph, 4–e. Have dated it 1921 as O'Keeffe thinks similar apples were painted about 1921." Backing inscription dates 1920? Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1921. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1921 . Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
